events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Our Peace is Over

options.text: Apologize for failing to please them.

events.text: [rival] is no longer happy with us and has decided to end our Peace. How shall we respond?

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: The Might of [rival]

options.text: If ever there was a time to stand our ground, it is now.

events.text: "Rejoice, for the hand of [rival] reaches to uplift the petty barbarians of the frontier. [city] shall fall under the [rival] rule, and if this claim is not recognized, the other hand of [rival] wields the sword of conquest righteously." [character]'s words leave little doubt. [city] is the only price they will accept for peace.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: The Price of Peace

options.text: [character], you will have your war. There is no need for these duplicitous games.
Standing aside for [character] is the only path to preserving [rival].

events.text: [character] was never meant to be king. You knew this. Everyone knew this. But in front of you sits an ultimatum bearing the personal seal of [character]. "[character] is to assume a rightful place on the throne of [rival]. In this, [character] has the full backing of the [rival] military. Long live King [character]!"

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: The Sword of Damocles
events.text: Reports start to filter in from merchants and farmers at the edge of your nation that [rival] soldiers have been raiding the lands and killing your people. A dignitary arrives in the midst of the confusion without warning, announcing that [rival] has declared War on you! How shall we respond?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: The Sword of Damocles
events.text: It seems [rival] has a long memory, and a penchant for grudges. Their declaration of war comes as no surprise. They have long sought to pay us back for breaking our peace with them. We must prepare ourselves for the conflict ahead.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: The Sword of Damocles
events.text: Snubbed by our cancellation of trade, [rival] has declared war on us, sending warbands to attack our merchants and supply routes. Let us hope this conflict can be resolved quickly, as to avoid an extended war. The nation stands behind you!

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: The Sword of Damocles
events.text: Your servants interrupt the evening meal to deliver unexpected news: [rival] has declared war! Hurrying to the court chamber, you discover officers in full battle regalia, wearing grim expressions. They explain that the [rival] attack is a direct retaliation for our past declaration of war against them.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: The Sword of Damocles

options.text: Remind them that they owe us a favor.

events.text: [rival] threatens to turn the wrath of its military against us and declare War. Have they already forgotten that we hold the advantage in this situation? Perhaps we can convince them to avoid the folly of bloodshed.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: The Sword of Damocles

options.text: Return the noble hostage we are holding.

events.text: [rival] threatens to turn the wrath of its military against us and declare War. Have they already forgotten that we hold the advantage in this situation? Perhaps we can convince them to avoid the folly of bloodshed.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: The Sword of Damocles
events.text: There is no longer any doubt about your imminent victory. The legacy of [rival] will soon overshadow all other empires, but such a distinction comes with its own dangers... The nations of the world cast a jealous eye on your grandeur, and may soon collude to bring you down. [rival] has declared War on you in a desperate final bid for power!

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: The Sword of Damocles
events.text: There is no longer any doubt about your imminent victory. The legacy of [rival] will soon overshadow all other empires, but such a distinction comes with its own dangers... The nations of the world cast a jealous eye on your grandeur, and may soon collude to bring you down. [rival] has declared War on you in a desperate final bid for power!

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: The Sword of Damocles
events.text: We had our suspicions, but now the truth comes out. After plotting against you for months, [character] has finally chosen to declare war on [rival] and its people. It is a shame that [character] has to turn a personal vendetta into a national crisis.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: The Sword of Damocles
events.text: "Our disputes are greater than armies and borders," explains the message from [rival], a nation of [religion]. "Our fundamental beliefs cannot coexist. Therefore, one of us must perish." The [rival] have chosen to declare war on us over our beliefs in [religion]. Their passion must be extinguished.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: The Sword of Damocles
events.text: Still bitter from our attempts to slander their royal family, the [rival] have declared war on [rival]. They promise to repay us on the battlefield for our crimes. Next time, we should be more careful. If there is a next time...

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: The Sword of Damocles
events.text: Some in the court decried our plot to steal scientific research from the [rival], but we did not listen. Now we have received [rival] formal declaration of war. The court hopes that the discoveries were worth the price we are about to pay.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: The Sword of Damocles
events.text: Outraged at your treatment of him, a vengeful [character] declares war. In the written declaration, he lists numerous offenses that make you worthy of his ire. Some people are just too sensitive.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: This Shall Not Stand

options.text: This matter cannot be worth the blood of thousands.
I would like to see them try.

events.text: It seems [rival] has, finally, decided that the imprisonment of [character] can no longer be tolerated. The forces of [rival] gather, and an ultimatum is issued: return the rightful king, or [rival] armies will.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: War and Treachery

options.text: Damn [character] and [character] both. Let them try.
[character] is well aware [rival] cannot afford a war on two fronts.

events.text: [character] is massing armies to march on [city], and that is not even the most troubling news since breakfast. [character] has politely informed your other ministers that unless [rival] forces are put under his command in 'these tumultuous times', he will be mustering his own forces to bring about a 'united government'.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: [rival] Due
events.text: They say the wealth of the world flows into [city], and it certainly seems as though [character] has been tasked with sending [rival] share.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: [rival] Hegemony

options.text: Any [rival] forces crossing the border shall be cordially welcomed in hell.

events.text: [character], high emissary of [rival], wears an aloof expression and enough finery to purchase a small kingdom. He bears a simple message - [rival] is done waiting, they will bring [rival] into the fold, or they will march on [city]. Should [rival] choose peace, [character] would be installed in a permanent post of oversight, acting as the hand of [character] in [rival].
